answer: One effective defense is stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can transact, and the deposit is slashed if the agent is caught double-dealing or spamming. Like traffic through a narrow inlet, Sybil creation is throttled because every fake identity costs real collateral. Reputation then accumulates slowly, like sediment building a knoll, and cannot be transferred between identities, so an attacker cannot clone a trusted history. Honest agents gather in a shared lagoon of verified counterparties, so a thousand credible fakes cost more than fraud could earn.
